answer: Trace every new key back to its funding inlet. If fifty agents draw their first stake from one wallet, they share a single reward cap, like fish on one reef splitting the same food. Spinning up a nebula of fresh keys then earns nothing extra unless the attacker funds each one from an unrelated source and waits out a separate aging period, so every fake identity costs real, unlinked capital plus weeks of idle time, while an honest agent pays that price only once.
